patch_description: Use a broader set of asymmetric five-row topologies, including the structurally distinct layouts suggested by the row-population portfolio, and seed them with small unequal radii. Unequal initial radii help SLSQP leave the overly rigid equal-radius contact graph. Rank optimizer outputs by their strictly feasible common-radius-scaled objective rather than their possibly slightly infeasible reported objective; this prevents selecting a nominally larger result which loses more during the final validity correction.
